description:
You are a product marketing manager. A CSV file named 'sales_data.csv' is available at 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\sales_data.csv' (columns include Product_Category, Customer_Type, Region, Sale_Date, Sales_Amount).

Your goal is to build a Power BI report named 'Small_Multiples_Report.pbix' and save it to the Desktop ('C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\').

The report must have a single page named exactly 'Category Comparison' containing:
1. A Line Chart showing 'Sales_Amount' (Y-axis) over 'Sale_Date' (X-axis), split into small multiples by 'Product_Category'.
2. A Clustered Bar Chart showing 'Sales_Amount' (X-axis) by 'Region' (Y-axis), split into small multiples by 'Customer_Type'.
3. A Card visual displaying a new DAX measure named 'Avg_Sale_Value' defined as: DIVIDE(SUM(sales_data[Sales_Amount]), COUNTROWS(sales_data)).

Ensure you configure the 'Small multiples' field well for the charts to achieve the split views.

Login: user is 'Docker', no password required.
